label: Watercooler

real.name: Rain
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_watercooler_enemy_Step_0.gml:88-99 — the `amimoonwarmer == false` arm of the ONLY dispatcher. amimoonwarmer is false in every reachable encounter: it is set true only by Create_0.gml:17-18 and Step_0.gml:3-7, both gated on `global.encounterno == 140`, and the Watercooler battle is encounter 139 (launched at obj_b3bs_watercooler_Step_0.gml:194, obj_b3bs_zapper_b_Step_0.gml:217, obj_dw_teevie_watercooler_Step_0.gml:123 and :215, obj_room_ranking_c_Step_0.gml:51). Controller type 135 -> obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:2749-2761 spawns ONE obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball at obj_growtangle.x/.y. The per-turn variant axis is dc.special, derived from `turns` (Create_0.gml:28 `turns = 1`; Step_0.gml:93-98, incremented Step_0.gml:110): turn 1 -> special 0 (static ball), even turns -> special 1 (widening horizontal sweep, obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball_Step_0.gml:97-101), odd turns > 1 -> special 2 (circular wobble plus swaying raindrop angles, ibid:103-118). Treat special like the Roaring Knight's difficulty axis: one attack, three authored flavours, all three reachable within the intended 4-turn fight (global.rank1turns = 4, scr_encountersetup.gml:1242).

cut.name: Moon (Moonwarmer)
cut.evidence: gml_Object_obj_watercooler_enemy_Step_0.gml:100-106 — the `else` (Moonwarmer) arm. It fires only when amimoonwarmer is true, which requires global.encounterno == 140. Encounter 140 is fully defined (scr_encountersetup.gml:1246-1264, '* A strong aura emanates from the Moonwarmer.') but NOTHING selects it: every scr_battle() call site for this enemy passes 139, no RoomCC or overworld enemy sets myencounter/encounterno to 140 anywhere in chapter 3 (grep over all `myencounter = ` / `encounterno = ` assignments yields 4, 16, 50, 52, 110, 111, 113, 118, 125, 126, 131, 132, 133-136 — never 140), obj_fusionmenu's dojoEncounter list is {100, 72, 71, 89, 90} (obj_fusionmenu_Step_0.gml:111-164), and the only other mention of 140 is obj_testoverworldenemy_Other_10.gml:14 picking battle music. Reachable ONLY through the debug obj_battletester (encountermin 110 / encountermax 999 for chapter 3, obj_battletester_Create_0.gml:10-13). NOTE: controller type 69 is not dead in chapter 3 generally — obj_rouxls_ch3_enemy_Step_0.gml:2925 and :2939 both use it — it is cut for THIS fight.

cut.name: Rain (twin rainballs)
cut.evidence: obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:2763-2784 — spawns TWO rainballs at obj_growtangle.x-50 / +50 with side -1/+1, threshold 7 and amount 2. No writer anywhere in chapter 3 sets `.type = 136`: the only `type = 135/136/69` assignments in the chapter are obj_watercooler_enemy_Step_0.gml:92 (135), :104 (69), obj_rouxls_ch3_enemy_Step_0.gml:2925/:2939 (69), and two RoomCC files for an unrelated board-dungeon object (gml_RoomCC_room_board_dungeon_3_21/22_PreCreate.gml, `type = 135` on a non-controller). Because amount therefore stays 1, the rainball's bullet-vs-bullet destruction branch (obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball_Step_0.gml:35-46, gated on `amount > 1`) is dead code in the real fight.

cut.name: Rain special 3 (ball orbits the box)
cut.evidence: obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball_Step_0.gml:120-129 — the ball is pinned to a 50px orbit around obj_growtangle and threshold drops from 3 to 8. The only writer of the rainball's `special` is obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:2757 / :2771 (`rainbullet.special = special`) from the controller, and the only writer of the controller's special on the type 135 path is obj_watercooler_enemy_Step_0.gml:93-98, which produces 0, 1 or 2 only.

cut.name: Rain special 4 (orbits + rotates its raindrops)
cut.evidence: obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball_Step_0.gml:120-141 — special 3's orbit plus a per-frame `mybulletangle += (1 * other.side)` rotation applied to every live raindrop. Same reasoning as special 3: no code path ever assigns special > 2.

mechanics:
Solo mid-tier encounter, not a multi-phase boss. Enemy obj_watercooler_enemy (objects.tsv: sprite spr_watercooler, parent obj_monsterparent), monstertype 58 (scr_monstersetup.gml:1699-1742): 1879 HP, AT 8, DF 0, mercymax 100, sparepoint 8, 200 gold, recruitcount 4 (Create_0.gml:2). Encounter 139 sets global.rank1turns = 4, so a 4-turn fight is the intended length (scr_encountersetup.gml:1228-1245).

ONE attack, dispatched with NO numeric selector. `myattackchoice` is a DECOY: Create_0.gml:10 sets it to 1 and Step_0.gml:18-21 toggles it 0<->1 on every enemytalk phase, but nothing ever reads it — the object's own Step never tests it, and the only cross-object reads of `myattackchoice` in the chapter are against obj_knight_enemy (scr_damage.gml:99, :270; scr_damage_maxhp.gml:78). The dispatcher branches on the boolean `amimoonwarmer` instead (Step_0.gml:88 / :100). `rr` is likewise a decoy for attack selection: Step_0.gml:32 increments it to pick balloon text and Step_0.gml:117 overwrites it with choose(0,1,2,3,4) purely to pick a battle message.

The real variant axis is dc.special, driven by turn parity (Step_0.gml:93-98): turn 1 -> 0, even -> 1, odd > 1 -> 2. `turns` starts at 1 (Create_0.gml:28) and increments at Step_0.gml:110.

Soul: plain RED. No green/purple/yellow mode, no minigame, no HP gate, no phase machine, no turn replacement, no second enemy object. The box is the untouched default obj_growtangle, created at view X+320 / Y+170 with maxxscale = maxyscale = 2 (obj_growtangle_Create_0.gml:13-14) and never resized. The Rain branch drops an obj_heartmarker at (box.x - 10, box.y + 18) so the soul spawns BELOW the rainball that occupies the box centre; the Moonwarmer branch deliberately skips the marker, so obj_moveheart falls back to (box.x - 10, box.y - 10) (obj_moveheart_Create_0.gml:6-20). That is why the heartmarker and scr_moveheart lines must be inside the boxBlock slice. obj_heartmarker has no event files at all — it is a pure position marker (objects.tsv:1408, visible False) destroyed one line later at Step_0.gml:75-76.

TURN LENGTH is layered and load-bearing. scr_turntimer only RAISES (scr_turntimer.gml:3-4), and global.turntimer is otherwise only decremented once per step (obj_battlecontroller_Step_0.gml:1420) or zeroed by scr_turn_skip/scr_gameover. The boss sets 200 at Step_0.gml:79 during mnfight 1.5; twelve frames later Step_0.gml:108's scr_turntimer(140) is therefore a NO-OP. For Rain, obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball_Create_0.gml:11 then calls scr_turntimer(300), so the real Rain turn is 300 frames; Moon (no scr_turntimer anywhere on the type 69 path) stays at 200. The rainball reads global.turntimer twice — Step_0.gml:35 (`> 10`, gates the twin-ball collision code) and Step_0.gml:79 (`< 10`, suppresses the splash animation at turn end) — so a wrong turntimer changes visible behaviour.

Rain shape: a single rainball sits at the box centre and every `threshold` (3) frames emits an obj_regularbullet at radius 150 with sprite_index 857 = spr_raindrop (sprites.tsv line 859; header on line 1, so 0-based id 857), which then falls INWARD (mybulletdist shrinks under mybulletgravity 0.2, mybulletspeed accumulating) until it reaches the ball's edge and splashes, growing the ball by 0.05 each time. Every 5th spawn is aimed near the soul (heartangle +/- 30) and every 6th exactly at it, then the counter resets (Step_0.gml:12-19). Bullet damage is 40 (scr_bulletspawner.gml: `damage = global.monsterat[myself] * 5`, AT 8).

Moon shape (cut): type 69 (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:810-894) drips obj_bullet_submoon at 35-frame intervals from a 180px arc above the box, each homing with turnrate 6 - special. Its damage model is a SPECIAL CASE: obj_bullet_submoon_Other_15.gml:3-7 checks `i_ex(obj_watercooler_enemy)` and, if so, calls event_user(2) on the boss instead of scr_damage. obj_watercooler_enemy_Other_12.gml then hits ALL THREE living party members for round(maxhp/4) each inside one invulnerability window. obj_bullet_snow_Other_15.gml has the identical hook, but snow belongs to type 70 (Rouxls) and never appears here. Also note type 69 tests `instance_exists(obj_rainwater)` for its is_water variant — obj_rainwater is only ever created by type 71 (obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:985) — so is_water is always 0 here, and the `special > 1` precipitation-shatter block (ibid:870-893) never runs because the Moonwarmer passes special 0.

ACTs (non-combat, but they gate flavour): Check, BegForMercy (unlocks ActCool/ActWarmer + Flirt on second use via global.flag[1119]; Create_0.gml:30-31 pre-seeds begformercycount = 2 on replays), ActCool (party gathers around the cooler, +25 mercy), Flirt (+10, or +14 if Susie and Ralsei are both down; sets global.flag[1144] = 1 for the Teevie curtain scene), plus S-Action and R-Action (+6, or +10 if the other two are down). Step_0.gml:191-436. None of them alter which attack fires.
engineNeeds:
Objects the studio must instantiate and step: obj_dbulletcontroller (type 135; type 69 only for the cut Moon), obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball (parent obj_regularbullet), obj_regularbullet, obj_growtangle, obj_heartmarker (event-less marker), obj_moveheart, obj_animation. For the cut Moon branch additionally obj_bullet_submoon (parent obj_celestial_body_parent -> obj_regularbullet) and the obj_precipitation_bullet_parent / obj_celestial_body_parent interaction.

Scripts: scr_bulletspawner (reads `myself` and `mytarget`, sets damage = global.monsterat[myself] * 5 = 40), scr_bullet_inherit, scr_bullet_create, scr_moveheart, scr_turntimer, scr_isphase, scr_lerpvar, scr_script_delayed, scr_approach, scr_at_player, snd_play_x.

Transpiler hazards in obj_watercooler_bullet_rainball_Step_0.gml:
  1. `bulletsprite = 857` (Create_0.gml:9) is a RAW numeric sprite id (spr_raindrop), not a name — the sprite table must resolve integer ids. The raindrop identity test is `with (obj_regularbullet) { if (sprite_index == mybulletsprite) ... }` (Step_0.gml:48-50, :110-112, :133-135) where mybulletsprite is a `var` local captured from the ENCLOSING scope inside a with-block.
  2. `destroybulletid` is a `var` local declared at Step_0.gml:3, ASSIGNED from inside `with (obj_regularbullet)` at line 62, and read after the with at line 67 — GML script-scope locals, not instance vars. A transpiler that rebinds locals per with-instance breaks the splash/grow loop entirely.
  3. Step_0.gml:61 reads `other.sprite_width` from inside a with over obj_regularbullet, i.e. the RAINBALL's width, which grows as `size` grows — the splash radius is dynamic.
  4. `collision_rectangle(..., obj_regularbullet, false, 1)` at Step_0.gml:37 (only live if amount > 1, i.e. cut content).

The boss Step declares `enum e__VW` at the BOTTOM of the file (Step_0.gml:445-464) while the box block uses __view_get(e__VW.XView, 0) at line 67 — same hoisting requirement as the Roaring Knight and Jevil slices.

To launch the CUT Moon variant the studio must set the boss instance's `amimoonwarmer = true` (or global.encounterno = 140 before Create), because both the box block and the dispatcher branch on it — there is no controller flag to set, unlike Jevil's joker = 1. Running Moon also needs the enemy's Other_12 wired as the submoon hit handler, otherwise damage silently falls back to the controller's 55 per hit instead of a quarter of every hero's max HP.

No selectorScan, extraAttackFiles or controllerSet entries are needed: the attack is announced and dispatched entirely inside obj_watercooler_enemy_Step_0.gml, and the only per-turn parameter (dc.special) is set by the dispatcher itself.
